_comment: SimHub property -> MOZA channel, for the .djson import path (UI/DjsonImport).
Telemetry.json's simhub_property gives a direct reverse index for 41 of the 137
distinct [Property] references in SimHub's stock DashTemplates. This file recovers
the ones that name the same quantity under a different property path, plus a few
that are derivable in wheel JS from channels that do exist.
Lookup is case-insensitive and 'DataCorePlugin.GameData.NewData.' is normalised to
'DataCorePlugin.GameData.' before matching, so either spelling works as a key.
Extending coverage is a data edit — add a row here, no code change.

aliases._comment: SimHub property path -> canonical v1/gameData channel URL. Every target verified present in Data/Telemetry.json.

_comment: SimHub property path -> a JavaScript expression evaluated ON THE WHEEL.
Use only where no single channel carries the quantity but it is derivable from
channels that do. Reference channels as CH(<url>); the resolver rewrites that to
Telemetry.get("<url>").value and records each url as a dependency.
Guard division — an absent channel reads back NaN.
Documented dead ends — no channel exists and none is derivable. Listed so the
conversion report can say WHY a binding was dropped instead of just 'unknown'.
These need the plugin-side NCalc fallback (claim a spare catalog channel and put
the expression in MozaProfile.TelemetryChannelMappings), which is out of scope.
unmappable.DataCorePlugin.GameData.SpeedLocalUnit: unit label, not a telemetry value
unmappable.DataCorePlugin.GameData.TyrePressureUnit: unit label, not a telemetry value
unmappable.DataCorePlugin.CustomExpression.CurrentD: user-defined expression, resolvable only in SimHub
